RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the August 8, 2006/Sravana 17, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Culture; Finance; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions —20
Agricultural loans disbursed by
Public Sector Banks
†*221. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that
Rs. 1,60,479.4 crore was disbursed as loan
by the Public Sector Banks in the rural
areas of the country by the end of March,
2005;
(b) if not, what is the actual amount;
(c) whether it is also a fact that this
amount is only 15 per cent of the total loan
given by the banks;
(d) if not, the details in this regard;
and
(e) the directions of the Reserve Bank
of India regarding the percentage of
agricultural loan to be made available?
Revision in fuel prices on monthly basis
*222. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are considering revision of fuel price in each
month;
(b) the break-up of basic price and tax
on per litre of petrol and diesel as on
30th June, 2006; and
(c) the details of the other countries
which have so far revised the petrol and
diesel price upwardly in recent past?
Refurbishing aircrafts of Indian
Airlines
*223. SHRI PRAVEEN
RASHTRAPAL: Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to merge Air India and Indian Airlines for
financial viability of the two airlines;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have recently
changed the name of the airlines to
INDIAN;
(d) if so, the reasons for change of name
of the airlines when the two airlines are
going to be merged; and

(e) how much amount has been spent
on the change of name and on refurbishing
of the aircrafts of INDIAN?
Task Force on river linking
†*224. SHRI KRISHAN LAL
BALMIKI: Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Task
Force constituted for river linking has been
dissolved;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the details of recommendations made
by the Task Force?
Selection of Independent Directors
*225. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
Will the Minister of HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of vacancies of
Independent Directors existing at present,
PSE-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that such
positions have remained vacant for years,
if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that absence of
required number of Independent Directors
on the Boards have precluded the PSEs
from exercising the autonomy offered to
them under the Policy;
(d) whether it is also a fact that there
have been cases when the Independent
Directors have been reappointed for another
term, if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) what steps are being taken to
streamline the procedure to ensure timely
selection of Independent Directors?
Recovery of dues from private airlines
*226. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that most of the
private airlines owe huge sum of money to
Airports Authority of India (AAI);
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether interest is being charged for
the period of default;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the steps taken to realise the dues?
Allocation of natural gas to Andhra
Pradesh
*227. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) what are the quantities of oil and
natural gas found so far in Andhra Pradesh
during the last two years;
(b) what are the quantities allocated to
the State Government and the State
industries;
(c) what are the quantities exploited so
far; and
(d) whether there is any proposal to
provide a fixed allocation of these two
resources to the State?
Supply of natural gas to North
Eastern Region
*228. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that oil PSUs are
paid compensation for supply of natural
gas to North Eastern Region;

70
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the rates at which natural gas is
supplied to North Eastern Region as
compared to other parts of the country
and whether they are for unrestricted
quantity;
(d) the amount of compensation paid
to different oil PSUs during 2005-06 and
expected to be paid during current fiscal;
and
(e) how it is ensured that natural gas
supplied to this region is not passed on to
neighbouring States?
